title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
summary: Find the largest profit from buying on one day and selling on a later day, given a list of daily prices.
followUps: Can you do it in one pass over the prices with O(1) extra memory?
What changes if you may complete as many buy-and-sell trades as you like, one share at a time?
How would you also return the buy day and the sell day?
